sloka: यो हि विक्लवया बुद्ध्या प्रसरं शत्रवे ददौ ।स हतो मन्दबुद्धित्वाद्यथा कापुरुषस्तथा ।। ७.६८.१९ ॥
transliteration: yo hi viklavayā buddhyā prasaraṁ śatrave dadau ।sa hato mandabuddhitvādyathā kāpuruṣastathā ।। 7.68.19 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, whoever gives an advantage to an enemy with a wavering mind is killed due to his dull-wittedness, just like a coward.
